items.note: Corrected on 15 October 2026 (M39): the middle cell reads "Compact initial sublevel where the representation holds" (before: "Compact initial sublevel in the structural region"). Row 1 of Table art:positive-outcomes. True as phrased: the cell cites Theorem art:centered and states its scope ("where the representation holds": the compact initial sublevel lies in the set U). Left implicit: F finite and convex with a minimizer x_*; on the open convex U, F = psi + gamma(. - x_*) with psi convex and locally C^{1,1} and gamma finite, convex, positively homogeneous of degree one ("centered smooth-sublinear"); "optimal values" means F(x_k)->F(x_*), with dist(x_k, argmin F)->0.
